chapter: Early life and the New Orleans band scene
title: Jazz originated with Black New Orleans bands; Lala born 1893
summary: Lala insists jazz was originated by Negroes, then called Right Time bands, and says he was born in 1893.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: It depends on just what time you want to talk about. I can start talking about 1910, 1908, all that. All the way back. Didn't tell nobody when you were born? All the colored bands. Really, you think jazz music wasn't originated by white people. It was originated by Negroes. And at that time it was called the Right Time Bands. More naturally, they went to North North and they called it jazz.
When were you born? I was born in 93. 93. So you remember? I remember. You remember way back.
